scope: Explainable 8-dimension application priority, mathematical divergence analysis (match vs priority), and multi-tier fresh job queue prioritization (new excellent matches processed ahead of stale lower-quality jobs via queue priorities).

acceptance.application_priority_dimensions: PASS; all 8 dimensions (match, posting age, salary, company preference, direct employer availability, application complexity, source freshness, expiration risk) evaluated with honest UNKNOWNs and honest weights without mutating underlying facts.
acceptance.divergence_analysis: PASS; mathematical delta (priority - match) classifies MATCH_DOMINANT, PRIORITY_BOOSTED, STRONGLY_ALIGNED, MODERATELY_ALIGNED with top booster and drag factors.
acceptance.fresh_job_queue_priority: PASS; multi-tier queue matrix assigns Tier 0 Critical to fresh (<24h) excellent (>=85%) matches, demoting stale (>30d) or weak matches (<60%) to lower tiers; queue ordering guarantees fresh excellent matches are processed first with zero jitter.
acceptance.operation_dispatch_integration: PASS; to_operation_dispatch_params outputs dispatch_priority == 'HIGH' for Tier 0 and Tier 1 jobs, integrating directly with workers outbox.
acceptance.frontend_components: PASS; FreshJobPriorityBadge and ApplicationPriorityPanel render accessible status badges, tier indicators, and explanations.
acceptance.safety: PASS; external submission OFF asserted; no external calls or unauthorized background processes.

checks.target: Fresh job queue priority tier calculation, ordering, stability, and dispatch params
Application priority divergence analysis and full evaluation
Integration test for database job queue prioritization and dispatch mapping
Frontend badge component rendering and accessibility
TypeScript check and Vite production client build
